LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_PetCat.label: pet cat specialization
LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_PetCat.description: A developing Pet Cat specialization. It improves movement speed and reduces the chance that wounded wild prey retaliates.
LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_PetCat.stages.0.label: forming
LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_PetCat.stages.1.label: agile
LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_PetCat.stages.2.label: elusive
LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_PetCat_Final.label: final pet cat specialization
LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_PetCat_Final.description: A final Pet Cat specialization shaped through personality gel. It grants 25% faster movement and greater hunting stealth. Gentle Comfort helps another player-faction humanlike pawn recover from a mental state or briefly boosts its mood and work speed.
LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_PetDog.label: pet dog specialization
LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_PetDog.description: A developing Pet Dog specialization focused on taming and training animals and working crops.
LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_PetDog.stages.0.label: forming
LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_PetDog.stages.1.label: obedient
LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_PetDog.stages.2.label: kennel-trained
LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_PetDog.stages.3.label: pack leader
LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_PetDog_Final.label: final pet dog specialization
LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_PetDog_Final.description: A final Pet Dog specialization shaped through personality gel. It improves taming and training and increases plant work speed by 40%. Animal Training lets the pawn approach an eligible animal on the same map, then directly tame a wild animal or complete one enabled training project for an owned animal after brief guidance in its cell.
LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_PetRabbit.label: pet rabbit specialization
LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_PetRabbit.description: A housekeeping specialization developed through cleaning, cooking, and training. Cleaning and cooking become faster at 20% progress. Both speeds increase further at 50%.
LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_PetRabbit.stages.0.label: forming
LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_PetRabbit.stages.1.label: skilled cleaner
LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_PetRabbit.stages.2.label: skilled housekeeper
LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_PetRabbit_Final.label: final pet rabbit specialization
LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_PetRabbit_Final.description: A final housekeeping specialization shaped through personality gel. It grants 70% faster cleaning, 50% faster cooking, and the Careful Cooking ability.
LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_PetRabbitCarefulCooking.label: careful cooking
LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_PetRabbitCarefulCooking.descr: Fully focused at the stove, the cook handles ingredients quickly and keeps the heat just right.
LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_RabbitCloneLink.label: rabbit clone
LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_RabbitCloneLink.description: This pawn is a clone split from a pet-rabbit specialist. It shares rest and mood with the source, matures rapidly, and cannot undergo personality excretion.
LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_RabbitCloneLowPNA.label: rabbit clone PNA production
LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_RabbitCloneLowPNA.description: A low-efficiency PNA output state stabilized after a rabbit clone reaches maturity.
LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_PetFox.label: pet fox specialization
LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_PetFox.description: A specialization developed through research, tending and training. Research speed, tending speed and tending quality improve at 20% and 50% progress.
LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_PetFox.stages.0.label: forming
LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_PetFox.stages.1.label: skilled researcher and medic
LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_PetFox.stages.2.label: research and medical specialist
LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_PetFox_Final.label: final pet fox specialization
LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_PetFox_Final.description: A final specialization shaped through personality gel. Research and tending are 50% faster, and the tending quality factor is 15% higher.
